
A defense tech company is looking for a
Senior Fullstack Developer
to join a dynamic development team working on complex systems in a private cloud environment. The role includes full ownership of the development lifecycle — from architecture design, through Front and Back development, to deployment in a production environment. The position is located in Tel Aviv, HaKirya, within an Air Force unit.
Requirements:

- At least 5 years of experience
- Familiarity with Next.js
- Strong knowledge of relational database management — PostgreSQL
- Experience in designing and implementing complex system architectures
- Ability to read code and conduct quality Code Reviews
- Use of AI development tools — Claude Code and similar
- Backend service development — TypeScript
- Writing Dockerfiles and building Docker Images
- Working with S3 / object storage
- Working with Git and branch management following Semver conventions
- Familiarity with the military system, particularly the Air Force — an advantage
- Graduates of the Ofek unit — an advantage
Technical advantages:

- Experience working on projects with multiple simultaneously available environments (development, integration, production)
- Familiarity with message queues — RabbitMQ / Kafka
- Experience in Backend service development — Python
- Experience with FastAPI
- Experience with Express
- Experience with OpenShift (configuration, troubleshooting)
- Familiarity with the MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Experience with permission management systems (RBAC, ABAC, etc.)
- Experience with data synchronization and connectivity systems between data repositories
- Experience with Elasticsearch
- Experience with Matomo
- Familiarity with neverthrow (functional error handling in TypeScript)
- Familiarity with CI/CD processes (particularly Woodpecker/ArgoCD)
Full-time position in Or Yehuda
